item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 01/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect southern China in the next couple of days. Winds are expected to strengthen from the east early next week and there will be one or two rain patches over the coast of Guangdong. Under the influence of a dry replenishment of the monsoon, it will be windy and slightly cooler over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Kong-rey will move across the East China Sea and continue to weaken today and tomorrow. It will gradually transform into an extratropical cyclone.
